kit.welcome: This kit sets up your computer so PEPTICITY runs on autopilot: your Concierge answers routine emails, watches the store and stock, and brings you only what needs you. It installs trusted apps straight from their makers and asks before every change.
promises: Installs apps only from their official makers: Windows' own app installer (winget), or the maker's signed installer where there is no winget package (Hermes).
Never asks for, sees or stores your passwords. You sign in to each account yourself.
Remote help stays off. It only turns on when you press the button, for 1 hour.
Writes a plain-English log of everything it did, in your Documents folder.
You can uninstall any app later from Windows Settings, like any other app.
